text:
maria: starting a short thread to align on Dedicated SKU bands + burst/quotas + autoscale gating. Need decisions for the Q3 roadmap doc: SKU definitions, burst window semantics, carryover policy, and autoscale hysteresis.

ajay: propose 3 SKUs (solo, team, scale). Map to 1, 4, 16 GPU-equivalents. Each SKU gets a default min_replicas and max_replicas.

ben: FYI infra constraints: cold-starts for large models are expensive (120-240s). Preemption requires draining KV caches which adds ~30s. Suggest conservative cooldowns.

clara: from Support: customers complain about sudden hard rejects. We should prefer soft quota (throttling + clear messages) and optional hard-enforce for enterprise contracts.

tal: UX note 1012: make burst buying and carryover explicit in the Console. Toggle and small explainer copy.

sophia: billing/legal: carryovers allowed only with explicit opt-in. Finance prefers selling burst as USD-minutes to avoid token confusion. Legal wants auditable activation & opt-in record.

ben: rough implementation sketch for autoscale config:
```
autoscale:
  sku_defaults:
    solo: {min:1, max:2}
    team: {min:1, max:8}
    scale: {min:4, max:64}
  cooldown: 180s
  scale_up_window: 45s
  preempt_order: [solo, team, scale] # configurable override per customer
  soft_quota_mode: true
```

ajay: preempt_order should prefer evicting opportunistic customers first; default above seems inverted. Also we should make preempt_order a priority list with explicit weights.

ben: good catch. I meant preempt_order: [opportunistic, solo, team, scale]. We'll provide a mapping for 'opportunistic' buckets.

maria: burst window length proposal: tiered by SKU: solo=10m, team=30m, scale=60m. Carryover: off by default for solo/team, opt-in for enterprise (scale).

clara: ops question: how do we show remaining burst in Console? Live counter + historical ledger per billing period is required.

tal: UX mock: buy burst -> choose window or "carryover enabled" -> confirm. I can do a quick mock by Tue.

sophia: finance: if we price in USD-minutes, reporting & invoicing simpler. But UX should show both tokens and USD equivalence. Fine to standardize on USD-minutes internally.

ben: effort estimate: quota service changes + migration + UI + billing hook. Ballpark 3 sprints backend + 1 sprint console + 1 sprint QA/docs = ~5 sprints. Risk: tiered windows + carryover increases complexity and test matrix.

ajay: prioritization suggestion: (1) soft-quotas + throttling UX, (2) tiered windows without carryover, (3) carryover (opt-in) + billing. Rollout via feature flag.

maria: decisions captured for roadmap: SKU tiers (solo/team/scale), tiered burst windows as Ajay suggested, default no carryover except opt-in for scale, soft-quota first, cooldown=180s.

maria: action items: Ben -> concrete dev plan + sprint breakdown by Mon EOD; Ajay -> pricing bands + SLO targets; Tal -> Console mocks Tue; Sophia -> confirm billing unit + legal opt-in language Tue; Clara -> support docs skeleton Wed. Review Fri 11:00.

ops-bot: event created: Dedicated Policy Review Fri 11:00, calendar invite sent.

maria: thanks all :rocket:
